last_verified.normal_state: Integrated codex/ws-localization-i18n commit efa7706baed554f65d2ec5c9adde61305479d607 as a shared user-space localization foundation and registered its durable state. Current integration-tree checks pass: 26 unit tests, Clippy with warnings denied, crate formatting, catalog check (2 locales/14 messages), and a Nagi user-target library compile. en-US and ja-JP are first-class catalogs; locale/system-language and region inputs remain separate; no process-global host locale is consulted. Settings, IME/input language, Albert conversation preferences, and first-party runtime consumers remain outside this checkpoint. The source branch Actions run 36215320154 passed Ubuntu and Windows host jobs plus target builds through UEFI, then failed only at the independent M17 QEMU first-web-pixel acceptance. Mainline M17 remains BLOCKED; M18 remains NOT STARTED.
